case_title.quote: SHER SINGH & ANR. v. STATE OF HARYANA

number_of_accused.reason: Five accused were convicted and are before the Court.

accused_gender.quote: Des Raj, Mange Ram, Surender, Sher Singh and Harish
accused_gender.reason: All five convicted accused are male; the woman was acquitted.

accused_occupation.quote: Sher Singh who was a teacher by profession
accused_occupation.reason: Counsel's submission states one accused was a teacher.

victim_gender.quote: Simla and Raj Kumar stepped forward to rescue Urned Singh and they too were attacked
victim_gender.reason: The deceased is male, but the victim's wife and son were also injured and are victims of the s.323 charge.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: they would teach Urned Singh a lesson for having interfered in the purchase of agricultural land

offence_category.quote: the intention of the accused to kill was evident
offence_category.reason: The Court restored the murder conviction.

weapon.quote: Balbir Singh armed with a Kulhari ... Surender with a bankri, Rajesh and Smt. Rajesh with a jailli
weapon.reason: Kulhari, bankri, jailli and lathis are all mentioned.

evidence_type.quote: relied primarily on the evidence of Bimla PW-2 and Raj Kumar PW-6, the two injured witness, Dr. V.K.Jain
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, site-plan and recovery evidence are all relied on.

confession.quote: on the interrogation of accused, Balbir Singh, a kulhari was also recovered

aggravating_circumstances.quote: 26 injuries in all were found on the person of the deceased

trial_court_outcome.quote: rigorous imprisonment for life and to a fine of Rs.300/- each

high_court_outcome.quote: conviction under Section 304 Part II read with Section 149 with a sentence of 5 years rigorous imprisonment and a fine

final_outcome.quote: the judgment of the trial court is restored in all respects
final_outcome.reason: The trial court conviction was restored.

offence_finally_established.quote: the judgment of the trial court is restored in all respects

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence, so no fixed term.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary, trimmed to 300 words and without the court-style finding on the defence witness's injuries.
neutral_facts.quote: There was no evidence to connect the injuries with the incident
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate, but it runs slightly over 300 words and states a judicial finding in its last sentence.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the prescribed punishment.

attempt_completion.quote: succumbed to his injuries at 1.10 P.M.
attempt_completion.reason: Death occurred, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.quote: 26 injuries in all were found on the person of the deceased

number_of_offences.reason: Three sections charged and all three convictions restored.

premeditation_planning.quote: the intention of the accused was evident and that was to cause death
premeditation_planning.reason: No premeditation finding, only intention to kill.

motive.quote: teach Urned Singh a lesson for having interfered in the purchase of agricultural land
motive.reason: The alleged land-purchase motive is correctly marked as alleged.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the plans ... prove the case of the prosecution with regard to the site of the incident beyond any doubt

witness_credibility.quote: the presence of Simla and Raj Kumar has been admitted by the defence

post_offence_conduct.quote: took him to the tubewell belonging to Balbir Singh accused where he was left bleeding. The accused then ran away

bail_history.quote: The appellants are on bail, they shall be taken into custody forthwith
bail_history.reason: Quoting the High Court's order, the accused were on bail.

trial_duration.quote: High Court vide its judgment dated 1st October 2008
trial_duration.reason: Dates correct; the trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: Mr. R.S.Cheema ... Mr. Sinha, the learned senior counsel for the appellants in Criminal Appeal No.1294/2009
legal_representation.reason: Accused's counsel are named; State counsel are not assigned individually.

investigation_status.quote: the police filed a charge-sheet against Balbir Singh and his sons

procedural_irregularity.quote: The delay in the lodging of the FIR, even presuming that there is indeed some delay, looses all significance
procedural_irregularity.reason: No lapse found by the Court.

appeal_history.quote: Criminal Appeal Nos. 97-98/2010 and 182-183/2010 are allowed.

prosecution_argument.quote: the incident had happened in the field of Urned Singh ... no delay in the lodging of the FIR

defence_argument.quote: the FIR had been recorded after an inordinate delay

legal_principle_applied.quote: the intention of the accused was evident and that was to cause death

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Binay Kumar Singh vs. State of Bihar 1997 (1) SCC 283 and Jayantibhai Bhenkarbhai vs. State of Gujarat 2002 (8) SCC 165
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Cases and citations match; all held inapplicable.

sentencing_rationale.quote: merely because most of the injuries were on the extremities would not be a reason to bring the case within Section 304 Part II

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: great damage had been caused as the fracture of the 9th and 10th ribs had damaged vital organs

other_sentence_order.quote: Ipso-facto the judgment of the trial court is restored in all respects.
other_sentence_order.reason: No other orders beyond restoring the trial court judgment.
